query: Our final delegation includes 29 approved team officials. Can all 29 sit with the substitutes during a match?
expected_answer: No. The match bench allows at most 11 team officials, one of whom must be the team medical doctor; officials must be on the start list and not suspended.
reason_for_test: Registration eligibility in 24.6 versus the separate match-bench capacity limit.

query: The substitutes are warming up behind their own bench while the match is being played. May they use the official footballs supplied by FIFA?
expected_answer: No. The warm-up described in article 32.5 may not involve any balls.
reason_for_test: Official-ball permission in 30.3 versus prohibition in match-time substitute warm-ups.

query: Our wearable player-tracking system is certified and registered with FIFA. May we put its antenna next to the coach inside the technical area?
expected_answer: No. Such additional equipment must be placed in the stadium area designated by FIFA, not in the technical area.
reason_for_test: General tracker permission in 30.4 versus antenna-placement restriction.

query: We are visiting a stadium for the first time on the day before our match. Are we allowed to walk on the playing surface to inspect it despite the ban on stadium training?
expected_answer: Yes. The familiarisation visit allows players and officials to inspect the pitch on foot wearing training shoes; it does not authorise a training session.
reason_for_test: Training prohibition in 34.1 versus permission for a familiarisation visit.

query: The referee has awarded six minutes of added time at the end of the second half. Should the stadium clock keep counting from 90 to 96?
expected_answer: No. The stadium clock showing elapsed play must stop at the end of normal time, at 90 minutes for the second half.
reason_for_test: Added-time display boards and match duration versus the stadium-clock stopping rule.

query: A defender has to take over in goal during a match. Does the emergency goalkeeper shirt need to display his usual shirt number and name?
expected_answer: No. The special goalkeeper shirts supplied for an outfield player taking over in goal have no names or numbers.
reason_for_test: Normal name/number requirements in 28.1-28.2 versus emergency shirt exception.

query: A club has 29 accredited officials. May an official who is suspended watch the match from the team bench?
expected_answer: No. A suspended player or team official may not sit on the team bench.
reason_for_test: Accreditation and list membership versus a suspension-based restriction.

query: A player has already received a yellow card and then receives a direct red in the same match. For the group-ranking conduct score, do we deduct one point plus another five?
expected_answer: No. Apply the combined yellow-plus-direct-red deduction of five points once; only one listed deduction applies per person in a match.
reason_for_test: Suspension rules versus the distinct numerical conduct-score rule.

query: Three clubs from one country each won their confederation championship during 2021-2024. Does the two-clubs-per-country cap necessarily exclude one of those winners?
expected_answer: No. The country cap has an exception where more than two clubs from the same country won the confederation premier competition during that period.
reason_for_test: Country cap versus title-winner exception.

query: The roof was closed during the match because the weather became severe. When the weather improves, may the referee reopen it before the final whistle?
expected_answer: No. A roof closed in those circumstances must remain closed until the end of the match.
reason_for_test: Initial roof discretion versus the restriction after weather-related closure.

query: A protest is filed immediately after the tournament final, within the normal two-hour reporting period. Can it still be accepted under the protest procedure?
expected_answer: No. Once the final match has ended, protests described in article 8 are disregarded, although the committee retains its power to act on disciplinary infringements on its own initiative.
reason_for_test: General reporting deadline versus the end-of-tournament cutoff; other grounds for inadmissibility may also apply.

query: A team medical doctor is also trained in safeguarding. Must the club hire a separate person to be its designated safeguarding and welfare officer?
expected_answer: No. The role need not be exclusive and may be assigned to the doctor or another trained accredited delegation member; the designated officer must complete the specified safeguarding course.
reason_for_test: Two mandatory roles do not necessarily require two different people.

query: Both teams make a substitution at the same stoppage in normal time. Does that interruption use a substitution opportunity for just one team or for each team?
expected_answer: It counts as a used substitution opportunity for each team.
reason_for_test: Shared clock stoppage versus separate team opportunity accounting.

query: Our opponent uses an additional permanent concussion replacement. Does our team get any extra regular substitution even though our own players are uninjured?
expected_answer: Yes. The opposing team receives an additional regular substitution.
reason_for_test: The queried entitlement belongs to the opposing team, not the injured player’s team.

query: Our club has already filled all 35 places on its final player list. During 27 June to 3 July, can it add two otherwise eligible players without using those 35 places?
expected_answer: Yes. Up to two new players may be added without counting towards the 35-player maximum; replacements and additions under 24.3(a-b) together may not exceed six, and the other registration and notification conditions still apply.
reason_for_test: General final-list size versus a dated exception.

query: We use only three goalkeepers in our final tournament squad. Is listing those same three enough for the earlier provisional player submission?
expected_answer: No. The provisional list requires at least four goalkeepers.
reason_for_test: Minimum of three for the final list versus four for the provisional list.

query: The stadium roof needs to be moved before kick-off, and the players are already warming up on the pitch. Can it be moved while they remain there?
expected_answer: No. The roof may only be opened or closed when no one is on the pitch.
reason_for_test: Authority to move the roof versus the pitch-occupancy condition.

query: A coach wants to use a tablet in the technical area for activities unrelated to tactics, coaching or player welfare. Does permission for handheld electronic devices cover this use?
expected_answer: No. Permission is limited to coaching, tactics or player welfare and is subject to the applicable rules.
reason_for_test: List of permitted devices versus purpose limitation.

query: FIFA approved our kits before we travelled. Does that approval mean the equipment can skip inspection at the Team Arrival Meeting?
expected_answer: No. Equipment that could be displayed in the specified locations must be rechecked and approved at the Team Arrival Meeting.
reason_for_test: Initial approval versus mandatory arrival recheck.

query: We have identified a player for our club’s final squad, but another participating club also wants him. Can both clubs register him on their final lists if he promises to play for only one?
expected_answer: No. A player may neither appear on more than one participating club’s final list nor play matches for more than one club.
reason_for_test: Provisional-list dispute process versus an explicit final-list prohibition.

query: The rules allow the club to inspect an unfamiliar stadium the day before playing. Can that visit include an official football training session on its pitch?
expected_answer: No. Official training sessions at stadiums before matches are prohibited; the permitted familiarisation visit is for inspection.
reason_for_test: Permission for access versus permission to train.

query: Will FIFA publish every player we submit on the provisional squad list, just as it publishes the final squad?
expected_answer: No. The provisional list is for internal use and is not published by FIFA.
reason_for_test: Publication of the final list versus confidentiality of the provisional list.

query: A referee is unable to continue in a match using VAR. The fourth official is not certified to referee with VAR. Does the fourth official still take over as referee?
expected_answer: No. In that situation the referee is replaced by a video match official.
reason_for_test: Normal fourth-official replacement rule versus a VAR certification exception.

query: Our team submitted its complete match start list on time. Can it be published immediately while the opposing team has not yet completed its own list?
expected_answer: No. Both start lists are published only after both teams have submitted fully completed lists.
reason_for_test: Individual submission deadline versus joint publication condition.
